preferred_image_flow.note: PRIMARY: Derouter REST image API (api-direct, 2K 16:9). Fallback: excalibur_blog_kie_gpt_image2_api.py when DEROUTER auth/5xx. FORBIDDEN: flux2-pro-*, Seedream, nano_banana*, z-image, mcp-derouter/start-mcp.sh.

mcp_args.prompt:
High-key bright RU editorial collage, airy #FFFFFF, sun flare, warm hospitality mood (apartment stay, not realtor deal). Comfort+ lived-in cozy interiors for ordinary guests (командировки, семьи, пары) — NOT business-class, NOT hotel-luxe, NO marble palaces. NO host face / NO Shakin / NO identity-real. NO brand logo in generation — factory pastes canonical PNG after split. NO…
Canvas 2048x1152 exact 2x2; four 16:9 panels (1024x576); thin white gutters; no bleed.
Ban: dark/low-key; inventory props; celebrity memes; EXCALIBUR stamp; chubby host; stock/generated man co-host on inline; large meme person on inline; icon slogans; empty cells; desk scene; cover copy; celebrity memes; stock model man; handsome realtor co-host; generated stranger presenter; large human on inline; meme person >15% frame; invented meme face.
TEXT LANGUAGE LOCK: all visible text is RUSSIAN Cyrillic only; exact LABELS per panel only.
Inlines: NO host face; NO stock/generated man; NO large human co-host/presenter; NO brand logo in generation (factory pastes PNG on 2–3 panels only, TOP-RIGHT pad); people-memes only as tiny stickers (≤15% frame, never top-right pad) from real templates in memory/cover/meme-top100.json; mix sketch/table/chart/scheme collage — not text walls.
Top-left inline: structure_diagram; «Если по-хорошему не вышло»; Flowchart ladder dispute: претензия→площадка→банк; red/gold nodes, collage tape.. TXT:претензия | площадка | банк | срок возврата. TOP-RIGHT clean margin; NO factory logo here; NO drawn logos/house/heart.
Top-right inline: чеклист вопросов до оплаты; «Как отличить нормальный залог от способа заработать»; Interactive checklist board toggle chips: сумма, срок, основания; sticky notes collage.. TXT:сумма до брони | срок возврата | основания | честный залог. TOP-RIGHT clean margin; NO factory logo here; NO drawn logos/house/heart.
Bottom-left inline: fact_card; «Как мы работаем с залогом в «Добром доме»»; Warm illustration card: cozy apartment detail + transparent deposit policy labels; sketch lines.. TXT:Добрый дом | Тюмень | без придирок | до брони. TOP-RIGHT clean margin; NO factory logo here; NO drawn logos/house/heart.
Bottom-right inline: schema_faq_ui; «Частые вопросы»; FAQ UI cards 4 Q&A with expand chevrons; small cat sticker bottom-left only.. TXT:залог обязателен? | уборка | фото заезда | проверка хозяина. TOP-RIGHT empty pad for ONE factory logo 8–12%; NO drawn logo/house/heart; NO multi logos.
Inline all: #FFF collage, gold/black Cyrillic labels, tape/pins/strings/paper scraps; high-key #FFF/gold; not noir; dense facts/numbers; exact TXT per panel; meme only if +meme AND sticker-scale; no human hero on inline; no icon soup; zero typos.
